purpose: Build scene-disjoint world-click training examples for the modality-neutral MonotoneQueryLikelihoodHead.

head_interface.training_target: binary primitive target aligned to the N canonical rows

split_contract.development_validation_rule: first 120 scenes after sorting sha256('radio-gs-agile3d-likelihood-split-v1\0' + scene_id), then scene_id

trajectory_contract.click_selector: released AGILE3D largest FP/FN error-cluster center with FP winning exact radius ties
trajectory_contract.trajectory_rollout_predictor: deterministic nearest accumulated signed click; positive wins exact distance ties
trajectory_contract.click_signs: ground truth is used only by the source-train harness to synthesize corrective clicks
trajectory_contract.registered_affinity: canonical world_point_soft_seed_matrix, one column per accumulated signed click
trajectory_contract.affinity_order_semantics: unordered set at the head; click order is retained only for provenance

primitive_contract.production_adapter: query-independent canonical primitive bundle with xyz, covariance, prior_probability, coverage, reliability, and primitive_to_point_index
primitive_contract.source_train_smoke_adapter: released 5 cm ScanNet quantized points used as identity primitive rows
primitive_contract.primitive_target: point target gathered through primitive_to_point_index after split authorization
primitive_contract.point_target: source-train object label on the released quantized point domain

forbidden_actions: training on existing AGILE validation/full312 trajectories
using Easy3D full312 predictions or metrics as learned-head targets
opening test PLY labels during dataset materialization
object- or scene-specific hyperparameter selection from test outcomes
